messages:
kevin_cs: Kickoff: Lunara private/VPC onboarding — quick sync on a few items before the handoff to infra. We hit two gotchas yesterday: audit-log retention defaults to 7 days in their Splunk forwarder, and their KMS key has a rotation policy that conflicts with our recommended customer-managed schedule. @david_sre can you confirm the opt-in for cross-account decrypt?

maria_cs: Thanks — noted. Also FYI customer has a renewal query: they asked if enabling our private deployment adds extra fees for external KMS. They want that clarified before signing the SOW. Probably a renewal risk if we don't answer by EOD tomorrow. :warning:

david_sre: I checked permissions — their account role (Lunara-Priv-Role) doesn't have kms:Decrypt for our central key alias/redwood/lunara. We'll need an IAM trust policy update or they can grant us a customer-managed key. Either works but different billing implications. @kevin_cs what's the SOW stance?

kevin_cs: SOW currently states "customer-managed KMS recommended; Redwood can operate with provider-managed keys for an additional per-month KMS fee". I'll flag pricing differences to their procurement. Meanwhile, we should propose a short migration plan: (1) grant cross-account decrypt with limited principal, (2) we test logs ingestion, (3) rotate to CMK in 30 days. 

onboard-bot: AUTOMATED CHECK: network routes verified (3/4), audit-forwarder config missing retention param, kms-policy mismatch detected.

sam_eng: For audit logs, set retention on the forwarder config to 90d in their ops cluster. Example snippet they should apply:

```
forwarder:
  destination: splunk://inputs.example
  retention_days: 90
  compress: true
```

If they can't change retention, we can apply a short-term mirror to our long-term bucket with their approval.

maria_cs: Action items: 1) kevin - confirm wording + pricing to procurement, 2) david - share exact IAM snippet for cross-account role, 3) sam - prepare the forwarder patch and mirror fallback instructions, 4) I'll schedule a 30-min call with Lunara tomorrow 9am PT and capture answers. Anything else? :calendar:

david_sre: IAM trust snippet (minimal):

```
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::LUNARA_ACCOUNT:role/Redwood-Priv-Agent"},"Action":"kms:Decrypt","Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:123456789012:key/abc-123"}
  ]
}
```

kevin_cs: Good. I'll message procurement now and loop back. If procurement stalls >48h mark as "renewal risk" and escalate to AMs. Thanks team :thumbsup:

maria_cs: Captured. I'll post the call invite and the pre-read with the SOW excerpt and the audit/KMS checklist. Closing this thread after the call notes are added.
